dedupe_keys.name: 富士山ハサートマッフ 改定版 disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 富士山ハザードマップ(改定版) [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡県. 富士山ハザードマップ（令和３年３月改定）の高解像度画像データ及びGISデータです。 富士山ハザードマップは、活火山である富士山の火山ハザードマップです。 火山災害の要因別に影響が及ぶおそれのある範囲を地図上で視覚的に分かりやすく描画したものです。 富士山火山防災対策協議会が令和３年３月に公表しました。 個々の火山現象を数値シミュレーション... Coverage: 静岡県. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡県. It offers 18 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
